notes: The split is the Phase E pair-grouped holdout; Phase F never re-splits.
Isotonic is the default map; Platt is the small-stratum fallback.
Calibration maps are fitted per slice; stratification is not pooled across L1 and L7.
Policy costs are design constants recorded in every model and run, never tuned on the holdout.
A stratum with one correctness class is uncalibratable and is reported as such; no value is imputed.
